what_it_shows: CPE sharing limited to 9 allow-listed domains; the test copied a CUI sheet out of a virtual desktop session; 1,140 CUI items in SYS-01

title: Control assessment: separation of duties
source_system: STD-04 draft; ERP vendor-master change log; sample of 25 of 212 bank-detail changes; bank portal approval report; CPE administrator list; Controller interview
what_it_shows: 23 of 25 sampled bank changes had call-back evidence and a second approver; 2 were accepted under the 'urgent' override with no call-back record; the 3 CPE administrators review their own activity in the weekly log review

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: SYS-01 company-administrator list; cloud role export; privileged access broker configuration; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: 9 Project Managers hold SYS-01 company-administrator rights; privileged access management covers cloud accounts only

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: VPN and virtual desktop gateway configuration; STD-01 draft; external scan of the 22 jobsite router addresses (2026-08-12)
what_it_shows: Client VPN and the CPE gateway require MFA; 7 of 22 jobsite routers expose their administration page to the internet, enabled by the installer's default

title: Control assessment: mobile devices
source_system: Device management inventory (2026-07-20); 2024 endpoint standard; sweep of all 26 FC-4 tablets (2026-08-12); SYS-01 mobile app sign-in settings
what_it_shows: Laptops, smartphones and the 110 managed tablets carry encryption, passcode and remote wipe; all 26 FC-4 tablets hold offline CUI sets; 40 unmanaged tablets, including 9 FC-4 tablets, connect to SYS-01 without a device compliance check

title: Control assessment: use of external systems
source_system: POL-04 approved external systems list; FC-4 CUI distribution list; 15 FC-4 subcontracts; external auto-forwarding report; interviews with 15 staff
what_it_shows: External auto-forwarding blocked and no personal storage exceptions found; CUI processed and stored in SYS-01 and sent to 14 trade subcontractors' own systems

title: Control assessment: literacy training and awareness
source_system: Training platform records; phishing simulation reports; toolbox-talk roster; interviews with 15 staff including 4 FC-4 field staff
what_it_shows: Annual awareness and payment-fraud modules and quarterly phishing simulations run (June 2026 click rate 6.4%); FC-4 field staff received no CUI awareness; no guidance was given when AI-003 was enabled or when AI-002 was deployed

title: Control assessment: role-based training
source_system: CPE onboarding records; 2025-03 CUI briefing roster; administrator vendor training records; HR and payroll privacy module records; FC-4 Project Executive interview
what_it_shows: CPE users receive no role-based CUI training before access or yearly; the only CUI training was a 2025-03 briefing for the original team; HR and payroll staff complete a privacy module before payroll administrator access

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports (2026-01 to 2026-07); CPE weekly review records (10 of 30 weeks); SIEM source list; Security Manager interview
what_it_shows: The MSSP reviews corporate records 24x7; CPE logs are reviewed by hand weekly, with 2 of 10 sampled weeks skipped; SYS-01 audit logs and SYS-02 vendor-master changes are not reviewed

title: Control assessment: control assessments and SPRS reperformance
source_system: 2025 SP 800-171 self-assessment and score worksheet; assessment plan; internal audit charter; audit committee minutes; reperformance of the P03 score calculation
what_it_shows: Independent firm and a plan approved before fieldwork; no full SP 800-171A self-assessment of the CPE since 2025-02; reperformance of the P03 score calculation gave -23 against the posted 71

title: Control assessment: baseline configuration
source_system: Baseline documents; router configurations pulled from 6 of 22 jobsite routers; tablet configuration sample
what_it_shows: Baselines documented and reviewed for laptops, cloud servers, enclave laptops and the virtual desktop image; none for jobsite routers, rugged tablets or trailer Wi-Fi; the 6 sampled routers had 6 different configurations; 4 routers installed in 2026 were set up by hand

title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Device management and cloud policy compliance reports; configuration scans of 10 cloud servers; router audit (2026-08-12); 20 CPE change tickets
what_it_shows: 9 of 10 scanned cloud servers met the benchmark; 7 routers with internet-facing administration and 40 unmanaged tablets have no enforced settings; router configuration changes are not monitored; 20 of 20 CPE changes approved

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: Device management and cloud inventories; tablet and router spreadsheet; floor-to-list and list-to-floor traces of 30 assets each at 3 jobsites and the yard
what_it_shows: 4 of 30 list-to-floor items not found (3 tablets, 1 router); 3 of 30 floor-to-list items missing from every inventory (2 tablets, 1 trailer Wi-Fi access point); no CMMC asset category, manufacturer or CUI location fields

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: 2026-03 restore test report; contingency plan; P05 BIA; STD-07 draft; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: One recovery test in the last 12 months (2026-03, estimating database and BIM/CAD servers), covering 1 of 7 High-criticality processes; no test of the CPE, an SYS-01 export, the ERP in billing week or the MBSS rebuild

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports (July 2026, 31 days); write-once retention settings; restore of one BIM folder; CPE retention settings
what_it_shows: Daily backups to a separate account and region with 35-day write-once retention and encryption; the restore of one BIM folder succeeded; no CPE backup beyond provider versioning and no company export of SYS-01 records

title: Control assessment: MFA for non-privileged accounts
source_system: Conditional access policies; SYS-01 external user authentication settings; sign-in tests
what_it_shows: MFA enforced for all company and CPE users; the 230 external SYS-01 users who could read CUI-marked folders sign in without MFA

title: Control assessment: replay-resistant authentication
source_system: Authenticator registration report; relayed push-approval test against a test tenant
what_it_shows: FIDO2 used by CPE users and 22 administrators; a test adversary-in-the-middle page relayed a push approval in the test tenant

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Password policy; 10 of 64 help desk MFA reset tickets; router credential audit; security key issuance log; credential vault settings
what_it_shows: 3 of 10 sampled MFA resets were done on employee ID and manager name with no call-back; 7 jobsite routers kept the default or a shared installer administrator password, not changed when 2 IT staff left in 2026

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident response plan (2024); 10 of 46 incident tickets; 2025 tabletop report; MSSP containment test on a sample endpoint; certificate record
what_it_shows: The MSSP isolated the test endpoint within minutes and sampled corporate tickets followed the plan; 2 of 5 corrective actions from the 2025 tabletop still open; no valid medium assurance certificate and no imaging kit for enclave laptops or tablets; CPE and jobsite events handled in business hours; 5 lost tablets in 2026 logged as equipment losses

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03; interviews with 15 staff; Section 889 report to the FC-2 Contracting Officer (2026-08-13); certificate record
what_it_shows: 11 of 15 interviewed staff knew to report within 1 hour; the 4 FC-4 field staff did not know that CUI outside the enclave must be reported; the Section 889 report was filed within 1 business day; no valid certificate for DoD cyber incident reports

title: Control assessment: media access
source_system: Walkthrough of the FC-4 trailer and headquarters project office (2026-08-12); tablet sweep; enclave laptop device control settings; cabinet photos
what_it_shows: Enclave laptops block removable storage; offline CUI sets on 26 FC-4 tablets are open to anyone using a shared tablet; printed CUI drawing sets on an open plan table in the FC-4 trailer on 2026-08-12; a locked plan cabinet arrived 2026-08-20

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Destruction certificates (12 laptops, 2026); copier lease return records; FC-4 trailer walkthrough; shred vendor contract
what_it_shows: Certified destruction of 12 laptops in 2026 and copier drives removed before return; printed CUI from the FC-4 trailer went to ordinary recycling until 2026-08-20, when a locked shred bin and cross-cut shred service with certificates began

title: Control assessment: physical access control
source_system: Badge system reports (headquarters, regional office, yard); FC-4 trailer walkthroughs (2026-08-11 and 2026-08-12); key and combination records; superintendent interview
what_it_shows: Badge readers and 1-year logs at headquarters, the regional office and the yard; the FC-4 trailer open to all trades during working hours, with inspectors and trade staff unescorted on both days; 2 FC-4 trailer keys unaccounted for and the trailer not rekeyed; trailer keys not inventoried at any jobsite

title: Control assessment: visitor access records
source_system: Visitor logs (headquarters, FC-4 trailer, July 2026); installation gate record for July 2026
what_it_shows: Visitor records kept 1 year at offices and in the trailer binder; the FC-4 trailer log missed 14 of 41 July visitors recorded at the installation gate; the trailer log is not reviewed or reconciled

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Termination sample (25 of 286); exit checklists; security key and badge return records; HR Director interview
what_it_shows: Credentials, devices, keys and badges retrieved for the sampled leavers; 3 of 25 field terminations disabled 2 to 6 days late

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and scanning
source_system: Scan reports Q1-Q2 2026; scan scope list; remediation tickets for 40 of 140 critical and high findings; external scan of the file-transfer portal
what_it_shows: Authenticated scanner updated daily; scans run quarterly and do not cover enclave laptops or jobsite routers; 6 of 40 sampled critical and high findings fixed late, including a file-transfer portal component open 45 days against a 15-day target

title: Control assessment: acquisition process
source_system: All 15 FC-4 subcontracts; 2025 federal subcontract template; 10 IT and SaaS contracts; 6 jobsite technology rental agreements; Director of Contracts and Compliance interview
what_it_shows: 14 of 15 FC-4 subcontracts that involve CUI lack DFARS 252.204-7012 and SP 800-171 terms; no DFARS 252.204-7021 rider in the template; the 10 sampled IT and SaaS contracts carry security terms; the 6 rental agreements assign no Section 889 responsibility

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Network diagrams (P04); cloud firewall rules; external scan of jobsite routers; file-transfer portal subnet configuration
what_it_shows: Cloud hub firewall and SD-WAN monitored by the MSSP; the file-transfer portal in a public subnet; no network path from corporate systems to the CPE; jobsite router traffic not monitored; 7 of 22 routers expose administration to the internet

title: Control assessment: cryptographic protection in transmission
source_system: Government-community cloud CRM; enclave laptop FIPS mode settings; SYS-01 vendor documentation; tablet sync settings
what_it_shows: The CPE and enclave laptops use FIPS-validated modules; CUI synced from SYS-01 to the FC-4 tablets used modules not confirmed as FIPS-validated

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch compliance reports; cloud server patch records; firmware versions of the 22 jobsite routers; firmware test records for office firewalls
what_it_shows: 98% of endpoints current and critical flaws fixed within 15 days; 9 of 22 jobsite routers run firmware more than 18 months old; router and tablet firmware not tracked

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM source list; MSSP use cases; simulated impossible-travel sign-in on a test account; CPE log settings; General Counsel monitoring opinion (2024)
what_it_shows: The MSSP escalated the simulated sign-in in 22 minutes; the CPE, SYS-01, SYS-02 vendor-master changes and jobsite routers are not monitored for attacks

title: Control assessment: supply chain controls (Section 889)
source_system: Section 889 screening procedure (2025); submittal logs for FC-1 to FC-4; rented equipment at the FC-2 jobsite; Director of Technology and Security Systems interview
what_it_shows: Screening covers installed equipment only; 6 rented private-label cameras from a covered manufacturer in use at the FC-2 courthouse jobsite, found 2026-08-12; the procedure has not been reviewed since 2025
